quest.title: Join the Eremites and Embrace a Wonderful New Life!
quest.description: In Aaru Village, it seems that a member of the Eremites is recruiting...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Join the Eremites and embrace a wonderful new life! Come, friend, would you like to hear about the Eremites?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, just listen up a bit. The Eremites is a good community to be a part of! We're free! We're united! Friendly, too!

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: And if you join up with us, you'll get the chance to fleece those tree-dwellers of their fat wallets. The Akademiya's researchers are a rich lot, and they're not ones to default on their payments either!

choices.text: I'm already in the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Eh? You're with the Adventurers' Guild? I mean... That's no obstacle, is it? C'mon, everyone's got a side hustle nowadays — and it's not like adventurers and mercenaries are really that different, you get what I mean?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think they're pretty different.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Well, we've got good food here too! Meat and fish are regulars on the menu!

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: And if you're lucky, you might even get to meet Dehya, the Flame-Mane! Now I... *cough*

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: *cough* Sorry, sorry, I spoke too quickly there.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: I haven't had anyone listen to my pitch for a while now, so I got a little excited there...

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Still, are you really not even going to consider joining us?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Alright, if you say so...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are you always recruiting people here?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Yes. I mean, it is my job, after all. Nowadays, able hands are in short supply everywhere — and nowhere is that shortage more acute than in the mercenary industry.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: *sigh* Well, I guess I can just tell you. We've got people, that's for sure, but our line of work is very dangerous. Things like escorting people are on the easier side — it's just tiring at most.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: But if your work involves researchers, then it's like putting your head on the block. You'll be blessed to come back in one piece...

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: After coming back from these missions, most of our members have to take at least ten days to half a month off... So we always need people to fill in those gaps.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Sumeru's a big place with lots of researchers, so we've got new work coming in every day. We're basically working round the clock at this point.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: So yeah, we need to get some new people, or we're going to buckle under the load.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: In that case, have you managed to find anyone who's on board?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: You mean here in this village? Hahaha... Nope. Not a one.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Actually, I should correct myself. It's more that the people I'd love to have join don't want to, and that I wouldn't take those who want to join.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: If you don't believe me, why don't we take a quick walk about together? Who knows, you might just be convinced by the time we're done.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: ...Kidding, kidding. I know you said you didn't want to join, and I won't force you. I'd just... y'know, like some company while I have a little walk.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I can go with you, no problem.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Hehe, thanks a lot. Let me see... Let's go look for Sania first. She's usually free in the day, but at night... Well, she's usually busy having important discussions with Jabari.

choices.text: I really do have my hands full with Adventurers' Guild business.
You've had some practice with this pitch, huh?
I've already got a ton of commissions on my plate.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: How worrying...

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Good afternoon, Sania! What are you buying?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: I've told you many times before, Atiyah, Jabari isn't interested in joining you, nor do I want him to go become a mercenary. I'm not going to help you convince him.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Well, that's a shame. With his culinary skills, Jabari'd do really well with us, and your family's financial standing would be improved greatly, too.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: And hasn't he said before that he'd like to go out and find work? If that's what he really wants, who better to recommend work than an old friend, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: Don't take anything he says seriously. He'll tell you that one day, and change his mind the next.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: In the end, he just can't bear to leave me here alone in the village... and I couldn't bear to see him slogging away by himself, either.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: What's more, you're asking that he risk his neck out there as a mercenary! Even if he wanted to go, I'd stop him for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Sania
dialogues.text: Let's just leave this topic be. I've got things to buy — go bother someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Phew... Well, alright then. You see, traveler? This is what work looks like for me every day.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Next up on my list of people to meet is Fodil. He was one of us once... but he quit.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Sure would be nice if I could convince him to make a bit of a comeback...

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Atiyah... Not you again.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Hehe, persistence is one of our virtues, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Well, then you should know that sticking to principles is mine.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Come on now, brother...

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: I've left the organization already. Don't call me that.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Right, alright, Fodil. You sure you're not considering coming back at all?

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: I know that some of us can be a bit... reckless, but most of us are perfectly law-abiding citizens!

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: I've said this before, Atiyah. I'm not going back.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: The things you speak of, I've already confirmed them with my own two eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Perhaps not all the Eremites are a lawless lot, and not every Eremite enjoys kicking those who have already gone down...

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: But ill deeds spread, Atiyah. All it takes is one person to act like the law is merely a suggestion, and everyone else will be affected by them.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: One person influences another, and if that group keeps acting a certain way, they will influence yet more people...

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: I'm sure you know what that means better than I do, Atiyah.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: It is all too easy to do evil in such an environment.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: You wish for me to return... just as I wish for you to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Perhaps from your perspective, the Eremites are not an evil organization even if they're not exactly honorable... But you can't always live in shades of gray.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: This is just a word of advice. You may do with it as you will.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: I know, chief.

dialogues.speaker: Fodil
dialogues.text: Alright. If you do leave and need a new line of work, I will help you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Heh, well, there's no way I can win an argument with Fodil, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: What's next? Right, right, let's rest a bit. I gotta say, my throat's getting tired after all that.

talks.objective: Go back and take a break

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: Hey, Uncle Atiyah! You still asking people to join the Eremites?

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Why, if it isn't Ayten. Did you tell your mother you were coming here?

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: I did! She's working, so I went to go play with Karima.

dialogues.speaker: Karima
dialogues.text: Hello, Uncle Atiyah!

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: Uncle Atiyah, what do you think? About the stuff we talked about last time.

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: I've been working out this whole time, and I've even been training with Karima.. She's never gonna catch me again in a race!

dialogues.speaker: Karima
dialogues.text: That one time doesn't count! It was because I didn't eat enough for lunch that day!

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: ...Anyway, I've been following the training plan you gave me...

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: So let me take the test again! Let's see if I'm good enough to join the Eremites!

choices.text: Ah, so this is what you meant by...

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Ahem! Alright then, Ayten. As a member of the Eremites, I will conduct the test once again!

response.speaker: Ayten
response.text: Alright! C'mon, Karima, you join in too. Let's do this together!

response.speaker: Karima
response.text: But I don't wanna join the Eremites... I just want to stay here in the village and protect everyone...

response.speaker: Karima
response.text: But it would be nice to get Uncle Atiyah to test my skills. I mean, I did ask Miss Candace for advice on how to train before!

response.speaker: Ayten
response.text: Wait, what? When did you...

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Hahaha! Good, good, that's the spirit!

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Alright, Ayten, stop pouting. If we get the chance, I'll bring you to go get some pointers from Dehya! How does that sound?

response.speaker: Ayten
response.text: Really!? You'd do that?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: We Eremites don't lie, kiddo.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: But before we begin the test, let's have this traveler show us the expected standards.

choices.text: Wait, I'm involved in this now?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: ...I haven't had the chance to do any demonstrations before. I couldn't just run around doing those and leave these kids here by themselves. That would be too dangerous... Anyway, thanks for your help, Traveler.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: #*cough* Anyway, our Traveler here's a very capable adventurer. I had to do a lot to get {M#him}{F#her} to come and give you a demonstration.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Better watch carefully now.

response.speaker: Ayten
response.text: Alright!

response.speaker: Karima
response.text: An adventurer, huh? As in, someone from the Adventurers' Guild?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: No matter whether you're a mercenary or a guard, you will always wind up coming across situations in which retreat is the best option.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: When that happens, we often live by the principle that the quicker we can get away, the better.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Thank you, Traveler. Now, let us quickly demonstrate... How to make a swift retreat!

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Here's our starting point. Now then, please demonstrate.

choices.text: Don't you usually do the demonstrations?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Oh, come on, do I look like I had time to demonstrate between my job and looking out for these kids?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: I'm counting on you, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: Wow!

dialogues.speaker: Karima
dialogues.text: You're... so fast...

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Very good! You were quick... and more importantly, very steady.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Watch and learn, kids.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Don't insist on pushing through every dangerous situation you get in. If you must retreat, retreat decisively!

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: That means you especially, Ayten.

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: I know, I know...

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Good. Let's move on to the next step... It's time for some live combat demonstration.

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: Ooh, awesome! My dad carved me a wooden sword that I carry with me. What about you, Karima?

dialogues.speaker: Karima
dialogues.text: I do have a small bow, though my mother only gave me arrows without tips...

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: Hahaha! That's alright! You have a sword and a bow, and your boundless courage. That's all anyone really needs to begin their adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Atiyah
dialogues.text: But remember not to run around aimlessly when you're outside the village. Stick with me and the Traveler at all times.

choices.text: You're really taking them outside the village?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Oh, don't you worry. I've scouted that area beforehand. There's just a bunch of sickly scorpions out there. They barely retain any offensive capabilities, so we should be alright.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: And whatever happens, the two of us will be there!

choices.text: So you're counting me in now?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Oh, come on, we're already here. You know, "in for one Mora, in for a thousand" and such! I'll make sure to pay you according to the Guild's regulations!

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Well, buckle up, kids. We're heading off!

response.speaker: Ayten
response.text: Woohoo!

response.speaker: Karima
response.text: I must admit... I'm a bit nervous.

choices.text: I don't remember agreeing to this...
We're going out with two kids in tow...

dialogues.speaker: Ayten
dialogues.text: Those scorpions are huge! Uh, should we really get any closer to them?

dialogues.speaker: Karima
dialogues.text: I shot them with my bow, but they didn't even flinch...

dialogues.speaker: Karima
dialogues.text: But you... you defeated them so easily...

choices.text: Well, that's many years of training for you.

response.speaker: Karima
response.text: But... Miss Candace said I'd improved...

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Chin up, Karima! You'll become strong eventually — but you've got to take it all one day at a time.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: You too, Ayten. If you keep training hard like this, it's only a matter of time before we'll let you in.

response.speaker: Ayten
response.text: Ohh, if only I could get Miss Dehya to teach me...

response.speaker: Karima
response.text: The next time I see Miss Candace, I'll get her to teach me more!

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Hahaha! That's the spirit!

choices.text: And in the end, you didn't get anyone to join.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: *cough* Hey now, didn't they ever tell you not to harp on a man's private woes?

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: We can talk about work later... and it's not as if my advertising has had no effect at all.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Lots of young men and women have left the village to see the outside world after hearing what I had to say... even if they didn't really want to join us.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Well, we can talk about that later. I have to bring these kids back to the village now. Their parents are probably at least a bit worried now that they've been out so long.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: Here's a little something for you, by the way. Thanks for coming all the way out here with me.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: *sigh* Now, how am I going to explain this to the rest of the Eremites when I go back for a debriefing...

response.speaker: Ayten
response.text: Uh, Uncle Atiyah, you haven't given us our tests yet.

response.speaker: Atiyah
response.text: That so? Ah, yes... yes. Let's go back to the village first, and then we'll do the test there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Basically, we just need to get over there as quickly as possible, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Honestly, Paimon's surprised by how easy that is...
